sources.title: Arizona football: Tre Smith named to 2026 Lott IMPACT Award preseason watchlist
sources.description: Arizona football is about to start up again with summer workouts and eventually training camp, but award watchlists have started to come out. Senior defensive lineman Tre Smith was added to the Lott IMPACT Award preseason watchlist. The award is given annually to the nation’s top defensive player, and is named after former USC safety […]
